text:
taylor_product: Customer asked for a written plan: retain audit logs 7 years under customer-controlled keys. They want search for e-discovery. We need a recommendation for Q2 roadmap and short list of guardrails.
maya_security: Two viable patterns: (1) export-first: monthly encrypted snapshots to customer storage + signed manifests; (2) in-place BYOK with per-tenant key references and attested writes. Export-first limits our compliance surface.
omar_engineering: Export-first is much faster to implement: snapshot worker, manifest signer, delivery retries. In-place BYOK requires key lifecycle, attestation verification at write, and more telemetry.
lex_sre: Ops asks: legal_hold toggle that immediately pauses expiry; proof-of-delivery logs; manifest verification steps; RTO for restores (we should propose a window). Also need a test plan for legal_hold exercises.
rachel_legal: Contract points: custody statement (we don't hold plaintext with BYOK), termination export window, chain-of-custody format, and who bears e-discovery costs. We need acceptance language to attach to SOW.
santi_sales: Customer prefers in-place for searchability but is open to indexed exports if pricing makes sense. They asked for a pilot timeline and ballpark pricing bands.
taylor_product: Draft acceptance criteria (short):
- retention_label: "long_audit" TTL=7y
- key_mode: "export_only" or "byok_in_place" (default to export_only for pilot)
- delivery: monthly encrypted snapshot + signed manifest (sha256 checksums)
- evidence_retention: manifest + receipt stored 10y
- legal_hold: API/CLI toggle w/ audit trail
- restore: documented RTO/RPO for restores (propose RTO=72h for pilot)
- search: optional indexing add-on (paid)
- SLA: snapshot completes within 72h of boundary or on-demand delivery within 24h request window
maya_security: Add requirement: customer provides key attestation token at enrollment (sample format: base64 PKCS#11 attestation). Exports must use envelope encryption with customer KEK. We'll publish an example token in the PR.
omar_engineering: Implementation notes: indexless cold storage by default, optional indexing job for e-discovery needs; manifest signer uses our infra signing key; delivery worker retries with exponential backoff. Rough effort: export-first pilot ~4-6w of 0.5 FTE + ops support; in-place BYOK pilot ~8-12w 1.2 FTE + audits.
lex_sre: Runbook skeleton items:
- how to flip legal_hold (CLI command + API call)
- manual export trigger flow and verification steps
- manifest verification example (sha256 checks) and restore steps
- oncall playbook for failed exports and missed SLAs
rachel_legal: I need final acceptance text by Tue EOD to draft SOW attachment. Also need to confirm liability language re: tampered exports vs custody.
santi_sales: Pricing approach: base(export-only) = storage+egress; indexed = +search fee; in-place BYOK = enterprise add-on (security addendum + higher audit costs). I'll draft bands.
taylor_product: Risk note: in-place retention increases audit surface and may force reclassification of SOC2 scope. Recommend export-first pilot; offer indexed search as paid add-on and in-place BYOK for enterprise with security addendum.
maya_security: Also: require annual attestation renewal and retention of delivery receipts. For ISO evidence mapping, we should record attestations + delivery proof in our control logs.
opsbot: Doc created: https://tiny.redwood/longplay-retention-proposal (internal)
taylor_product: Action items:
- taylor_product + maya_security: finalize acceptance criteria PR to /docs/retention-playbooks by Tue EOD (owner: taylor_product)
- omar_engineering: provide firm estimate + staging plan by next Mon
- lex_sre: publish runbook skeleton by next Mon
- rachel_legal: draft SOW attachment & custody wording by Wed
- santi_sales: draft pricing bands + customer-facing proposal by Tue
- schedule 30m customer sync Thu 9:30am PT (I will send invite)
rachel_legal: ack. tagging @customer-success for handoff after draft exists. :white_check_mark:
omar_engineering: I'll prototype snapshot manifest format and include a sample in the PR:
```
{
  "snapshot_id": "snap-2022-09-01-0001",
  "object_count": 128,
  "sha256_manifest": "3a7bd3...",
  "delivery_time": "2022-09-01T02:00:00Z",
  "signed_by": "redwood-signing-key-v1"
}
```
lex_sre: Good. Include hash-chaining guidance for integrity verification.
taylor_product: Keep thread short here. If anyone blocks, ping me directly. We'll firm up the proposal and present to the customer next week.
